title: Frame by frame: the art of animation
creator_credit: Paul Burnford Film Productions, Pyramid Films, Paul Burnford and Jerry Samuelson
brief_description: This film explores the possibilities of making a frame-by-frame, or animated film. Illustrates a variety of frame-by-frame techniques: still-picture filming (kinestasis), flicker-framing, cut-out animation, people animation (pixillation), direct images on film, and time sequence filming. This film is suitable for upper secondary levels.
